known.title: Gate: the local close test misses real repository conditions

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - close a pushed Forge pull request in local mode while a GitHub test job is queued.
The repair removes the queued check from the local-mode fixture, but still does not exercise an existing pull request or copy `.forge/always-tests.txt`. The fixture starts an unpushed branch and reports no open PR (`tests/test_close.py:229` and `:310`), so it bypasses the pre-push wait in `src/forge/checks.py:252`. The real picker also includes the repository's required tests (`src/forge/fasttest.py:835`), which the fixture cannot observe. Consequently, the test still passes while local close waits for a GitHub job and runs unrelated required tests. The existing pre-push test uses CI mode, and the required-rules test verifies that those tests run; neither proves the local behavior requested by the previous finding.
findings.title: Gate: the local close test misses real repository conditions
